acceptance: A clean linked worktree created through make worktree-create at freshly fetched origin/develop passes agent-write-preflight and can start release-cut without checking out develop in the primary clone.

New-cut preflight rejects clean HEADs ahead of or behind origin/develop, a dirty checkout, and an existing release branch or tag conflict before modifying version files; the release branch's first parent is the exact accepted origin/develop SHA.
Resume of an uncommitted vX.Y.Z cut remains possible without discarding its curated CHANGELOG; a committed or pushed cut is not silently recreated.
Focused tests cover exact-head acceptance, ahead/behind rejection, dirty checkout, and resume; make pr-preflight passes on the implementation PR.

description: Make the existing release-cut target usable under BenchBox's linked-worktree policy and reject unreviewed or omitted source commits. Prior art: make worktree-create fetches origin/develop, creates an allowed named branch, pins identity, and records its base (scripts/worktree_lifecycle.sh:136-185); release-cut currently accepts only local develop or vX.Y.Z, fetches origin, then branches from local develop (Makefile:1074-1098). Extend the existing target rather than adding a parallel release command. For a new cut, fetch origin before deciding eligibility, require a clean linked checkout whose HEAD equals the fetched origin/develop commit, and create vX.Y.Z from that exact commit. Preserve the current guarded resume behavior for an uncommitted vX.Y.Z cut. Decision: whether to allow only a worktree-create branch or any clean linked-worktree branch at that exact SHA; choose the smallest rule compatible with the existing worktree metadata and preflight. Keep release version explicit. Do not write in the primary clone, loosen agent-write-preflight, bypass required release checks, reset unrelated work, or force-push protected refs. The next release operator must choose a version only after checking the existing v0.4.1 branch and PyPI/tag state.
